project.description: Playwright end-to-end suite for Acme Shop, with cross-build test history.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BASE_URL
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Environment to run against. dev: https://dev.acme-shop.test staging: https://staging.acme-shop.test prod: https://acme-shop.test

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: RERUN_FAILED_ONLY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Re-run only the tests that failed last time. The history report is skipped on these runs, because a partial result set would look like every other test disappeared from the suite.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
npm ci npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
# ---- SECTION 1 of 2 ------------------------------------------------------ # Only needed if this job does NOT use the Workspace Cleanup plugin. Without # it, a run that dies before writing results.xml leaves the previous build's # files behind and the report records stale results as this build's. rm -rf ./playwright-report/* ./triage-report # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
npx playwright test --project=chrome EXIT_STATUS=$?
# ---- SECTION 2 of 2 ------------------------------------------------------ # Cross-build test history report. # # Deliberately one line: backslash continuations are the most common way this # breaks after somebody edits it in the Jenkins UI. # # --init is NOT here. Add it for the very first run to create the store, then # take it straight back out - see docs/jenkins-setup.md, step 5. if [ "${RERUN_FAILED_ONLY}" = "true" ]; then echo "Partial run - skipping the history report." else node tools/triage/triage-report.js --junit playwright-report/results.xml --build "$BUILD_NUMBER" --branch "$BRANCH_NAME" --env "$BASE_URL" --url "$BUILD_URL" --job "acme-shop-e2e" --store /var/jenkins_home/ci-data/triage/acme-shop-e2e --out triage-report/index.html fi # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
exit $EXIT_STATUS
